info.name: ShipFinder Global Maritime Data History Dataset API

params.name: key
params.description: Your personal Shipfinderer API key to verify service permissions

params.name: port_code
params.description: Standard 5-digit port code

params.name: start_time
params.description: Start time of historical berthing records, represented as a Unix timestamp. Both start_time and end_time are mandatory, defining the closed query interval [start_time, end_time]. A single query is limited to a maximum of 1 year (366 days) of port call records.

params.name: end_time
params.description: End time of historical berthing records, represented as a Unix timestamp.

params.name: type
params.description:
Optional query type:
1=Query by ATA (Actual Time of Arrival);
2=Query by ATD (Actual Time of Departure).
Default: 1

params.name: time_zone
params.description: Time zone type (optional): 1=Local time zone (UTC if unavailable); 2=UTC+8; 3=UTC (Greenwich Mean Time). Default value: 2

Returned data includes vessel basic details, port call records at the target port, and the corresponding previous/next port of call records for each vessel.

params.description: 9-digit numeric code of MMSI

params.name: imo
params.description: 7-digit numeric code of IMO

params.name: ship_name
params.description:
Vessel name. 
Note: Port call records for all distinct vessels sharing the same name will be returned if duplicate vessel names exist.

params.name: call_sign
params.description:
Call Sign.
Matching Rule: Spaces are optional; letters are case-insensitive. The sequence and quantity of letters and digits must be consistent with the queried call sign.
Note: Port call records for all distinct vessels with an identical call sign will be returned if duplicate call signs exist.

## Description
The Ship-to-Ship (STS) Events queries whether a specified vessel has had ship-to-ship (STS) operations within a specified time period. If STS events are detected, it will return details of the paired vessel, as well as the STS position, coordinates, start time and end time of the event.
